description: This file contains mock class definitions for the IMediaPipeline and IMediaPipelineFactory interfaces, used for unit testing media pipeline components in the Rialto project. It defines mock methods for media pipeline operations and a factory mock, facilitating testing without real media processing.

classes.name: MediaPipelineFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipelineFactory interface, used to create mock media pipeline instances.

classes.name: MediaPipelineMock
classes.description: Mock class for the IMediaPipeline interface, providing mock implementations for media pipeline operations.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a mock media pipeline instance with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline's client.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by its ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Checks if data is available for a given status and request ID.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the pipeline.
